lines: You just paid five different influencers. Congratulations — you may have bought the same audience five times.
Because different creators can share thousands of identical followers.
Follower counts make your campaign look massive. Unique reach tells the real story.
This is the invisible influencer tax — and most brands never see it.
Yoloco reveals audience overlap before you spend — so every creator adds new reach, not another invoice.
Would you rather hire five influencers — or reach five different audiences?
